create_functional_optimizer: create a functional optimizer by wrapping a Sonnet optimizer class with the optimizer decorator
build_transformed_optimizer: build a TransformedOptimizer with init and apply methods for functional training loops
test_optimizer_init: test the optimizer init function to create initial optimizer state from model parameters
run_optimizer_apply: run the optimizer apply function to update model parameters and optimizer state with gradients
review_split_on_trainable: review the _split_on_trainable function that separates optimizer state into trainable and non-trainable entries
